purpose: Bounded read-only source-track semantics audit before the Copland source-track-links implementation.

anchors.finding: Reads component kind and signed source-track number, then calls NewTrackLabel(short, short).
Loads the signed 16-bit component kind at object offset 0x60.
Packs kind in the low 16 bits and track number in the high 16 bits.
Compares the recorded track number and the child component's kind before returning a component.

commands: xcrun llvm-objdump --macho --arch=arm64 --disassemble "$binary" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; ranges=[(0x1dd5bc,0x1dd5e0),(0x214530,0x2145d4),(0x2555e0,0x2555e8)]; [print(line,end="") for line in sys.stdin if (m:=re.match(r"\s*([0-9a-f]+):",line)) and any(a<=int(m[1],16)<b for a,b in ranges)]'
limits: Static instruction inspection supports track-number plus media-kind matching, not array-position matching.
FindTrackByLabel compares exactly; SearchForLabel has a number-zero wildcard. A universal SourceClip track-zero rule was not established.
Raw-short equality does not establish supported semantics for every arbitrary numeric media kind.
No Media Composer playback, timeline inspection or exact-media-set acceptance was performed.
